summary.text: Teresa Fox, a Republican from Bremerton who has worked as an emergency manager, safety professional, and fire inspector, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Washington's 6th District to Emily Randall.
She advanced from the August 4 primary with about 25% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Fox lives in Bremerton and is listed as a Republican. According to the Bainbridge Island Review's July 2026 candidate summary, she received an associate's degree from Olympic College, worked for the college as an environmental health and safety director, and later worked as a regional safety and health coordinator with the state Department of Labor and Industries.
Ballotpedia lists her professional experience as an emergency manager, safety professional, and fire inspector.
Fox advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary with 25.05% of the vote (32,006 votes) in the count reported August 6, and faced Democratic incumbent Emily Randall in the general election.
She described her platform as lower taxes, less regulation, and government accountability.
She received 36.2% of the vote to Emily Randall's 63.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
